# RNAseq ECM Analysis

To look at the gene expression of ECM genes across primary and recurrent GBM in CGGA data sets. 

## Library

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(httr)
library(pheatmap)
library(biomaRt)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
```
## Download and upload input data

Data downloaded from https://www.cgga.org.cn/download.jsp

Data that are already downloaded are not downloaded again. Chunks are skipped using , eval = FALSE in chunk. 

### Download mRNAseq_693 data

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Download expression data from STAR+RSEM (FPKM Value) 
GET(
  "https://www.cgga.org.cn/download?file=download/20200506/CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip&type=mRNAseq_693&time=20200506",
  write_disk(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip"), overwrite = TRUE),
  timeout(600)
)

# Unzip file and remove __MACOSX folder
unzip(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip"), exdir = "/Data/Inputs")
unlink(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "__MACOSX"), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

# Download clinical meta data
GET(
  "https://www.cgga.org.cn/download?file=download/20200506/CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip&type=mRNAseq_693_clinical&time=20200506",
  write_disk(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip"), overwrite = TRUE),
  timeout(600)
)

# Unzip file and remove __MACOSX folder
unzip(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip"), exdir = "/Data/Inputs")
unlink(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "__MACOSX"), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

```

## Filtering data to only include samples that follow WHO 2021 classification. 


Removed Samples that are not classified as GBM.

```{r}
# Load CGGA-693 metadata
cgga693_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Load CGGA-325 metadata
cgga325_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_325_clinical.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}

# Filter CGGA-693: keep GBM/rGBM, remove IDH mutant, remove 1p19q codel
cgga693_meta_gbm <- cgga693_meta %>%
  filter(tolower(Histology) %in% c("gbm", "rgbm")) %>%
  filter(tolower(IDH_mutation_status) != "mutant") %>%
  filter(tolower(`1p19q_codeletion_status`) != "codel")

# Filter CGGA-325: keep GBM/rGBM, remove IDH mutant, remove 1p19q codel
cgga325_meta_gbm <- cgga325_meta %>%
  filter(tolower(Histology) %in% c("gbm", "rgbm")) %>%
  filter(tolower(IDH_mutation_status) != "mutant") %>%
  filter(tolower(`1p19q_codeletion_status`) != "codel")
```

The meta data shows many columns describing the phenotype of each sample. Within the meta data, irradiation status is listed as 0 or 1. Gene expression profile of ECM genes should be analyzed between recurrent tumors that received irradiation and tumors that did not. This may give insight into irradiation induced ECM change. 

## Add filters to gene expression data

```{r}
# Load CGGA-693 gene expression data
cgga693_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Load CGGA-325 gene expression data
cgga325_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_325.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

### Filter expression data using filtered meta data

There is a problem using select() function, so the code below specifies to use dplyr 

```{r}
# cgga 693 filter
ids_693 <- intersect(colnames(cgga693_expr)[-1], cgga693_meta_gbm$CGGA_ID)

cgga693_expr_filt <- cgga693_expr %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_Name, dplyr::all_of(ids_693))

cgga693_meta_gbm_ord <- cgga693_meta_gbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(CGGA_ID %in% ids_693) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(ids_693, CGGA_ID))

# cgga 325 filter
ids_325 <- intersect(colnames(cgga325_expr)[-1], cgga325_meta_gbm$CGGA_ID)

cgga325_expr_filt <- cgga325_expr %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_Name, dplyr::all_of(ids_325))

cgga325_meta_gbm_ord <- cgga325_meta_gbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(CGGA_ID %in% ids_325) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(ids_325, CGGA_ID))
```

## Load non-glioma control to environment

```{r}
# Load the control expression data
control_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA_RNAseq_Control_20.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```


## Load GO ECM Gene set

```{r}
# ECM genes from GO:0031012 

ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

ecm_genes_raw <- getBM(
  attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "ensembl_gene_id", "go_id", "name_1006"),
  filters    = "go",
  values     = "GO:0031012",  
  mart       = ensembl
)

# Clean to unique, non-empty human symbols
ecm_genes_tbl <- ecm_genes_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(hgnc_symbol), nzchar(hgnc_symbol)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(hgnc_symbol, .keep_all = FALSE)

# Final for filtering expression
ecm_gene_list <- unique(ecm_genes_tbl$hgnc_symbol)
```

### Add gene set filter to expression data

#### 693

```{r}
cgga693_expr_ecm <- cgga693_expr_filt %>%
  filter(toupper(Gene_Name) %in% toupper(ecm_gene_list))
```

#### 325
```{r}
cgga325_expr_ecm <- cgga325_expr_filt %>%
  filter(toupper(Gene_Name) %in% toupper(ecm_gene_list))
```

#### Non-glioma control

```{r}
# Rename gene_name to Gene_Name for consistency
control_expr <- control_expr %>%
  rename(Gene_Name = gene_name)

# Filter for ECM genes
control_expr_ecm <- control_expr %>%
  filter(toupper(Gene_Name) %in% toupper(ecm_gene_list))
```

## Combine all three gene expression data sets for analysis

```{r}
# Check for duplicate genes

cgga693_ecm1 <- cgga693_expr_ecm %>%
  mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

cgga325_ecm1 <- cgga325_expr_ecm %>%
  mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

control_ecm1 <- control_expr_ecm %>%
  mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Quick check
nrow(cgga693_ecm1); nrow(cgga325_ecm1); nrow(control_ecm1)
sum(duplicated(cgga693_ecm1$Gene_Name))
sum(duplicated(cgga325_ecm1$Gene_Name))
sum(duplicated(control_ecm1$Gene_Name))

# Find common ECM genes
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  cgga693_ecm1$Gene_Name,
  cgga325_ecm1$Gene_Name,
  control_ecm1$Gene_Name
))

length(common_genes)  # number of ECM genes common to all 3
head(common_genes)    # preview the first few

# Filter common ECM genes and sort
cgga693_ecm_common <- cgga693_ecm1 %>%
  filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes) %>%
  arrange(Gene_Name)

cgga325_ecm_common <- cgga325_ecm1 %>%
  filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes) %>%
  arrange(Gene_Name)

control_ecm_common <- control_ecm1 %>%
  filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes) %>%
  arrange(Gene_Name)

# Check they all have the same gene order
identical(cgga693_ecm_common$Gene_Name, cgga325_ecm_common$Gene_Name)
identical(cgga693_ecm_common$Gene_Name, control_ecm_common$Gene_Name)

```
```{r}
# Step 4a: ensure sample-column names are unique across cohorts
samp_693 <- setdiff(colnames(cgga693_ecm_common), "Gene_Name")
samp_325 <- setdiff(colnames(cgga325_ecm_common), "Gene_Name")
samp_ctl <- setdiff(colnames(control_ecm_common), "Gene_Name")

# If any overlaps, append cohort suffixes
overlap_693_325 <- intersect(samp_693, samp_325)
overlap_693_ctl  <- intersect(samp_693, samp_ctl)
overlap_325_ctl  <- intersect(samp_325, samp_ctl)

if (length(overlap_693_325) > 0 || length(overlap_693_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(cgga693_ecm_common)[match(samp_693, colnames(cgga693_ecm_common))] <-
    paste0(samp_693, "_693")
}
if (length(overlap_693_325) > 0 || length(overlap_325_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(cgga325_ecm_common)[match(samp_325, colnames(cgga325_ecm_common))] <-
    paste0(samp_325, "_325")
}
if (length(overlap_693_ctl) > 0 || length(overlap_325_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(control_ecm_common)[match(samp_ctl, colnames(control_ecm_common))] <-
    paste0(samp_ctl, "_CTRL")
}

# merge by Gene_Name (inner joins are safe; all have same genes/order)
merged_expr_ecm <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) dplyr::inner_join(x, y, by = "Gene_Name"),
  list(cgga693_ecm_common, cgga325_ecm_common, control_ecm_common)
)

# Step 4c: sanity checks
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(merged_expr_ecm$Gene_Name))
stopifnot(length(setdiff(common_genes, merged_expr_ecm$Gene_Name)) == 0)
sum(duplicated(colnames(merged_expr_ecm)))  # should be 0

dim(merged_expr_ecm)
head(merged_expr_ecm[, 1:6])

```
```{r}
# make sample-level metadata that matches merged column names

# Current sample IDs in the merged matrix
merged_samples <- colnames(merged_expr_ecm)[-1]

# 693 meta -> keep IDs present in merged columns; label group from Histology
meta693 <- cgga693_meta_gbm_ord %>%
  transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    group = ifelse(tolower(Histology) == "rgbm", "rGBM", "GBM"),
    cohort = "CGGA693"
  )

# 325 meta
meta325 <- cgga325_meta_gbm_ord %>%
  transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    group = ifelse(tolower(Histology) == "rgbm", "rGBM", "GBM"),
    cohort = "CGGA325"
  )

# Control meta: build from control expression column names that made it into 'merged'
# (after you possibly renamed columns with _CTRL)
ctl_ids <- setdiff(colnames(control_ecm_common), "Gene_Name")
metaCTL <- tibble(
  sample_id = ctl_ids,
  group = "Control",
  cohort = "Control"
)

# If we added suffixes earlier (_693, _325, _CTRL), mirror them here
add_suffix_if_needed <- function(df, suffix) {
  needs_suffix <- any(grepl(paste0(suffix, "$"), merged_samples))
  if (needs_suffix) df$sample_id <- paste0(df$sample_id, suffix)
  df
}

meta693 <- add_suffix_if_needed(meta693, "_693")
meta325 <- add_suffix_if_needed(meta325, "_325")
# Control already derived from the post-filter table (which may already include _CTRL), so no change

# Combine all sample metadata and keep only those that exist in merged
sample_meta_all <- bind_rows(meta693, meta325, metaCTL) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% merged_samples) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 693 extra metadata
meta693_extra <- cgga693_meta_gbm %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CGGA_ID,
    `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    Radio_status = `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    Chemo_status = `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  )

# 325 extra metadata
meta325_extra <- cgga325_meta_gbm %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CGGA_ID,
    `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    Radio_status = `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    Chemo_status = `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  )

# Control extra metadata
metaCTL_extra <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = setdiff(colnames(control_ecm_common), "Gene_Name"),
  Radio_status = NA_integer_,
  Chemo_status = NA_integer_
)

# Apply suffixes
meta693_extra <- add_suffix_if_needed(meta693_extra, "_693")
meta325_extra <- add_suffix_if_needed(meta325_extra, "_325")
metaCTL_extra <- add_suffix_if_needed(metaCTL_extra, "_CTRL")

# Combine and join into sample_meta_all
meta_extra_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(meta693_extra, meta325_extra, metaCTL_extra)

sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta_extra_all, by = "sample_id")

# Check result
head(sample_meta_all)

# Sanity check
stopifnot(setequal(sample_meta_all$sample_id, merged_samples))

# pivot merged expression to long and join sample meta
merged_expr_ecm_long <- merged_expr_ecm %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Gene_Name, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "expression") %>%
  left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id")

# Optional cleanups
merged_expr_ecm_long <- merged_expr_ecm_long %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Control", "GBM", "rGBM")),
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("Control", "CGGA693", "CGGA325"))
  )

# Quick peek
dim(merged_expr_ecm_long)
head(merged_expr_ecm_long)
table(merged_expr_ecm_long$group, useNA = "ifany")

```
## Normalization, QC, and batch effect correction

### Normalize and clean up new table
```{r}
merged_expr_ecm_long <- merged_expr_ecm_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    log2_expr = log2(as.numeric(expression) + 1),
    Radio_status_lbl = dplyr::case_when(
      Radio_status == 1 ~ "Treated",
      Radio_status == 0 ~ "Untreated",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Chemo_status_lbl = dplyr::case_when(
      Chemo_status == 1 ~ "Treated (TMZ)",
      Chemo_status == 0 ~ "Untreated",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Control", "GBM", "rGBM")),
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("Control", "CGGA693", "CGGA325"))
  )

```

### QC to find outliers and scale differnces in data
```{r}

ggplot(merged_expr_ecm_long, aes(x = sample_id, y = log2_expr, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, width = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(~ cohort, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "ECM genes: per-sample log2(FPKM+1) distributions",
       x = "Sample", y = "log2 expression") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

```
### Batch effect correction

```{r}
# Wide matrix: genes x samples
expr_mat <- merged_expr_ecm %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Gene_Name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Align metadata to columns
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(expr_mat), sample_id))
stopifnot(identical(sample_meta_all$sample_id, colnames(expr_mat)))

# Log2 transform
expr_log2 <- log2(expr_mat + 1)

# ---- Tumor-only batch correction ----
idx_tumor   <- which(sample_meta_all$group != "Control")
idx_control <- which(sample_meta_all$group == "Control")

expr_tumor   <- expr_log2[, idx_tumor, drop = FALSE]
expr_control <- expr_log2[, idx_control, drop = FALSE]

tumor_meta <- sample_meta_all[idx_tumor, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("GBM","rGBM")))

batch_tumor  <- factor(tumor_meta$cohort)               # <-- key fix
design_tumor <- model.matrix(~ group, data = tumor_meta)

expr_tumor_adj <- removeBatchEffect(expr_tumor, batch = batch_tumor, design = design_tumor)

# Recombine (preserve original sample order)
expr_adj_tumoronly <- expr_log2
expr_adj_tumoronly[, idx_tumor]   <- expr_tumor_adj
expr_adj_tumoronly[, idx_control] <- expr_control

# Long format
expr_adj_tumoronly_long <- expr_adj_tumoronly %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene_Name") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Gene_Name, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_expr_batch_adj") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id")

# Quick checks
dim(expr_adj_tumoronly_long)
head(expr_adj_tumoronly_long)

```
### Check batch correction with PCA

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

# (Optional) drop zero-variance genes to avoid warnings
keep_genes <- apply(expr_log2, 1, var) > 0
X_before <- t(expr_log2[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE])       # samples x genes
X_after  <- t(expr_adj_tumoronly[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE])

# PCA
pca_before <- prcomp(X_before, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_after  <- prcomp(X_after,  center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# % variance
ve_b <- (pca_before$sdev^2) / sum(pca_before$sdev^2)
ve_a <- (pca_after$sdev^2)  / sum(pca_after$sdev^2)

# Data frames for plotting
df_b <- as.data.frame(pca_before$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(state = "Before (log2 FPKM)")

df_a <- as.data.frame(pca_after$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(state = "After (tumor-only adj)")

pca_df <- bind_rows(df_b, df_a)

# Limited color palette (your preference)
group_cols <- c(Control = "grey40", GBM = "#1f77b4", rGBM = "#d62728")

# Plot BEFORE
ggplot(df_b, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group, shape = cohort)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA BEFORE batch correction",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100*ve_b[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100*ve_b[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

# Plot AFTER
ggplot(df_a, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group, shape = cohort)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA AFTER tumor-only batch correction",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100*ve_a[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100*ve_a[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

```
## DEG analysis

### Compare DEG between control, GBM, and rGBM.

#### Prepare meta data

```{r}
# Make sure sample metadata matches the columns in expr_adj_tumoronly
sample_meta <- expr_adj_tumoronly_long %>%
  distinct(sample_id, group) %>%
  slice(match(colnames(expr_adj_tumoronly), sample_id))

# Set factor order
sample_meta$group <- factor(sample_meta$group, levels = c("Control", "GBM", "rGBM"))

```

Build design matrix and contrasts
```{r}

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = sample_meta)
colnames(design) <- levels(sample_meta$group)

contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  GBM_vs_Control  = GBM - Control,
  rGBM_vs_Control = rGBM - Control,
  rGBM_vs_GBM     = rGBM - GBM,
  levels = design
)

```

Run Limma
```{r}
fit <- lmFit(expr_adj_tumoronly, design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

deg_GBM_vs_Control  <- topTable(fit2, coef = "GBM_vs_Control", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
deg_rGBM_vs_Control <- topTable(fit2, coef = "rGBM_vs_Control", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
deg_rGBM_vs_GBM     <- topTable(fit2, coef = "rGBM_vs_GBM", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

```

Save the .csv

```{r}
write.csv(deg_GBM_vs_Control,
          "/Data/Outputs/DEG_GBM_vs_Control.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)

write.csv(deg_rGBM_vs_Control,
          "/Data/Outputs/DEG_rGBM_vs_Control.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)

write.csv(deg_rGBM_vs_GBM,
          "/Data/Outputs/DEG_rGBM_vs_GBM.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)

```

#### Plot Volcano 

```{r}
make_volcano <- function(deg,
                         title = "Volcano",
                         padj_col = "adj.P.Val",
                         lfc_col  = "logFC",
                         padj_cut = 0.05,
                         lfc_cut  = 1,
                         label_n_each = 0,     # set >0 to show labels
                         label_by = c("absLFC","padj")) {

  label_by <- match.arg(label_by)
  stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(deg)))
  df <- deg %>%
    mutate(gene = rownames(deg),
           padj = .data[[padj_col]],
           lfc  = .data[[lfc_col]]) %>%
    filter(is.finite(padj), is.finite(lfc)) %>%
    mutate(neglog10 = -log10(padj),
           status = case_when(
             padj < padj_cut & lfc >=  lfc_cut  ~ "Up",
             padj < padj_cut & lfc <= -lfc_cut  ~ "Down",
             TRUE                                ~ "NS"
           ))

  # choose labels (optional)
  pick <- function(d) {
    if (label_by == "absLFC") d %>% arrange(desc(abs(lfc))) else d %>% arrange(padj)
  }
  lab_up   <- df %>% filter(status=="Up")   %>% pick() %>% slice_head(n = label_n_each)
  lab_down <- df %>% filter(status=="Down") %>% pick() %>% slice_head(n = label_n_each)
  labs <- unique(c(lab_up$gene, lab_down$gene))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = lfc, y = neglog10)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#d62728", Down = "#1f77b4", NS = "grey70")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text_repel(data = subset(df, gene %in% labs),
                    aes(label = gene),
                    max.overlaps = Inf,
                    box.padding = 0.35,
                    point.padding = 0.2,
                    min.segment.length = 0,
                    seed = 123) +
    labs(title = title,
         x = expression(log[2]~fold~change),
         y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~italic(p))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

# Build the three plots 
p1 <- make_volcano(deg_GBM_vs_Control,  title = "GBM vs Control",  label_n_each = 10)
p2 <- make_volcano(deg_rGBM_vs_Control, title = "rGBM vs Control", label_n_each = 10)
p3 <- make_volcano(deg_rGBM_vs_GBM,     title = "rGBM vs GBM",     label_n_each = 10)

# Print them one by one
p1; p2; p3

```

```{r}
print_pair_counts <- function(g1, g2, label = NULL) {
```

### Compare DEG using Chemo and Radio status

```{r}
run_simple_deg <- function(group_filter, status_col, status_labels,
                           csv_path, volcano_title, pdf_path,
                           lfc_cut = 0.25, label_n_each = 10) {
  
  # subset
  idx <- which(sample_meta_all$group == group_filter & 
               !is.na(sample_meta_all[[status_col]]))
  Y   <- expr_adj_tumoronly[, idx, drop = FALSE]
  sm  <- sample_meta_all[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # factor for treatment
  sm[[status_col]] <- factor(sm[[status_col]], 
                             levels = c(0,1), 
                             labels = status_labels)
  
  # design + contrast
  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + sm[[status_col]])
  colnames(design) <- status_labels
  
  # get actual column names from design
  col1 <- colnames(design)[1]
  col2 <- colnames(design)[2]
  contrast <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(col2, " - ", col1),
                            levels = design)
  
  # limma
  fit  <- lmFit(Y, design)
  fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contrast))
  deg  <- topTable(fit2, coef = 1, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  
  # save CSV
  write.csv(deg, csv_path, row.names = TRUE)
  message("Wrote: ", csv_path)
  
  # volcano
  p <- make_volcano(deg, title = volcano_title, lfc_cut = lfc_cut, label_n_each = label_n_each)
  ggsave(pdf_path, plot = p, width = 6, height = 5, units = "in")
  message("Saved: ", pdf_path)
  return(p)
}

```

### Print top DEG for ctrl vs GBM/rGBM

```{r}

# thresholds (match your volcano cutoffs)
padj_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut  <- 1

# helper to read + standardize column names
read_deg <- function(path) {
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename(gene = `...1`) %>%           # gene symbols
    rename(log2FC = logFC, padj = adj.P.Val)  # standardize for easy filtering
}

rgbm_df <- read_deg("/Data/Outputs/DEG_rGBM_vs_Control.csv")
gbm_df  <- read_deg("/Data/Outputs/DEG_GBM_vs_Control.csv")

# filter to "volcano significant"
rgbm_sig <- rgbm_df %>%
  filter(padj < padj_cut, abs(log2FC) > lfc_cut) %>%
  arrange(padj)

gbm_sig <- gbm_df %>%
  filter(padj < padj_cut, abs(log2FC) > lfc_cut) %>%
  arrange(padj)

# counts
cat("rGBM vs Control: ", nrow(rgbm_sig), " significant genes\n", sep = "")
cat("GBM  vs Control: ", nrow(gbm_sig),  " significant genes\n", sep = "")

# print gene lists to console
cat("\nSignificant genes (rGBM vs Control):\n")
print(rgbm_sig$gene)

cat("\nSignificant genes (GBM vs Control):\n")
print(gbm_sig$gene)

# save full significant tables
write_csv(rgbm_sig, "/Data/Outputs/DEG_rGBM_vs_Control_significant.csv")
write_csv(gbm_sig, "/Data/Outputs/DEG_GBM_vs_Control_significant.csv")

# also save "genes only" lists if you want quick copy/paste
write_lines(rgbm_sig$gene, "/Data/Outputs/DEG_rGBM_vs_Control_sig_genes.txt")
write_lines(gbm_sig$gene,  "/Data/Outputs/DEG_GBM_vs_Control_sig_genes.txt")
```
